description: Financial history of one metric from SEC filings, newest first: revenue history, net income history, EPS history, cash flow history and more, by year, quarter or trailing twelve months. Up to 200 periods, each with its 10-K or 10-Q, filing date and SEC link.

limit.description: Number of periods, newest first, 1 to 200 (default 20)

metric.description: The metric to return: revenue, net_income, eps_basic, eps_diluted, operating_income, total_assets, total_liabilities, equity, cash, operating_cash_flow, capex, free_cash_flow, shares_outstanding, revenue_contract

period.description: annual, quarterly or ttm (trailing twelve months)

ticker.description: Stock ticker, for example AAPL or BRK.B

name: get_history
title: One metric over time
